description:
E2
Actress Kristen Bell recounts how her nurturing nature and her good works, such as co-founding No Kid Hungry, was sparked when she was age 19 and helped deliver two babies during a missionary trip to a clinic in Brazil.

title: Beyond the Spotlight
description:
E1
Shaquille O'Neal, who went from being poor and bullied to NBA stardom, reveals how his stepfather taught him the valuable lesson that "true pressure is not knowing where your next meal is coming from.".

title: Beyond the Spotlight
description:
E3
Actors/spouses Samuel and LaTanya Jackson have fought for civil rights around the globe, but their greatest satisfaction comes from handwritten thank you notes from children they have supplied with books.

title: Beyond the Spotlight
description:
E5
Inspired by his mother to be "of service," LeVar Burton entered the seminary at 13 years old; after deciding the Church didn't have the answers to his life questions, he changed his focus to theater arts and became known for Roots and Star Trek.

title: Beyond the Spotlight
description:
E6
Joe Namath grew up in Beaver Falls, Pennsylvania, near Pittsburgh. After his parents' divorce, Joe turned to sports; he was propelled into sports stardom in college and professional football earning the nickname Broadway Joe.

title: Beyond the Spotlight
description:
E4

title: Age of Big Cats
description:
E1
Saber-tooths rule the Pleistocene Era but the arrival of the new cats, early snow leopards, cheetahs and jaguars, mark a turning point in the evolutionary track.

title: Age of Big Cats
description:
E2
The era of the sabretooth is over and the biggest big cats ever, the lion and the tiger, become the kings of their respective habitats.

title: Age of Big Cats
description:
E3
Changes the planet has undergone affects big cats, from the almost complete disappearance of American wildlife to the rise of man; threats to big cats' survival.

title: Earth: The Nature of Our Planet
description:
E3
A miraculous mantle envelops the entire planet - a thin skin of gasses called 'air'. Without it, there would be no life or weather, no habitable conditions, or protection from lethal ultraviolet radiation or meteorites from outer space.

title: Earth: The Nature of Our Planet
description:
E1
It's the solid crust of our planet, the perfect element in which to record the stories of deep time and of lifetimes. Change and progression is the way of earth. Air and water turn solid rock into soil.

title: Earth: The Nature of Our Planet
description:
E2
How the flow of water has the power to shape all inhabitants on Earth, produces climate-changing weather and supporting species, from the largest whales to microscopic plankton.
